note: Baseline 2026-09-16 = 1 FORBID VIOLATION + expect_nodes 0/2. Two UNRELATED services whose topics come from env/config, so no literal is readable on either side. Both fall back to the framework tag `queue_*:kafka` and QueueStackResolver joins tag to tag, manufacturing a cross-service QUEUE_FLOWS edge that blast_radius traverses and cross_stack_trace labels as a real mechanism. A2.3 keeps the node (it is a real coverage signal: 'this file talks to Kafka, topic unknown') but respells it `unresolved:kafka` and teaches the resolver to skip that prefix, so the tag is structurally unpairable. Graded on the qname and the forbidden pairing, never on a raw QUEUE_FLOWS count.
